reviewed.meaning: Composite Moon: the relationship's emotional habits and needs. Composite Sun: the relationship's identity, direction, and purpose. Square: these two parts can be difficult to satisfy at the same time.
reviewed.experience: What you are building together and what helps the relationship feel close and settled do not always line up. reviewed.experience: Endurance and the ability to restructure support each other here, so the collaboration can sustain a long project and still change an arrangement that has stopped fitting. Commitment and adaptability serve the work. The blind spot is holding an old split because it is easier than reopening it.
reviewed.advice: Trust how much your collaboration can carry, and update the terms as the work changes.
